sources.entry: You-Get - Tiny command-line utility to download media contents (videos, audios, images) from the web. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/soimort/you-get) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: You-Get
summary.one_liner: You-Get is a tiny command-line utility for downloading videos, audio, images and other binary files from the web.
use_cases: Download YouTube videos from the terminal
Stream an online video into a media player without a browser
Batch download files into designated folders via scripts
Scrape and save images from a web page
Download private videos using exported browser cookies
summary.what_it_does: You-Get is a command-line tool that downloads media (videos, audios, images) from websites such as YouTube, Youku and Niconico, with a list of supported sites on the project pages. It can list available qualities and formats (-i) and download a chosen one by itag. It can also feed a video into a player such as mpv or vlc instead of saving it, and it can download arbitrary non-HTML files directly by URL. For other pages, a universal extractor scrapes the page for interesting resources, and non-URL input triggers a Google search for a video. Downloads can be interrupted and resumed via a temporary .download file, and it supports HTTP proxies and cookie files.
notable: Can hand video off to a media player (-p) instead of downloading, so no browser or ads are needed
Universal extractor scrapes web pages for images and other resources on sites not explicitly supported
Resumes interrupted downloads using a temporary .download file
Installable via pip, Homebrew, FreeBSD pkg, Flox, Antigen, or from GitHub
caveats: Format selection is not implemented for most supported sites; the highest-quality default is used
ffmpeg is required for merging multi-part streams and for YouTube 1080p and higher
JSON output (--json) and --url extraction are not stabilized and may change
Support for Python 3.5, 3.6 and 3.7 will eventually be dropped
Universal scraping is experimental and far from perfect
